caption:
Suspicion, spying, backbiting: one verse on all three

Allah tells the believers to avoid much suspicion, not to spy on one another and not to backbite, and compares backbiting to eating the flesh of a dead brother. Then He reminds us that He is Accepting of Repentance, Most Merciful.

Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:12

Next time a conversation turns to someone absent, change the subject

#backbiting #guardyourtongue #surahhujurat #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: O you who believe, avoid much of the suspicion, for some suspicions are sin. Do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would surely abhor it. So fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Accepting of Repentance, Most Merciful (Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:12)
